services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: We were born for field trips. Across 8.5 acres, indoors and out, LCM gives kids of all ages the chance to learn with their senses. LCM requires one (1) adult chaperone for every five (5) children. Accompanying adults must be 18 years old or older to qualify as a chaperone. We strongly encourage schools to work within this ratio in order to ensure that students have the best possible field trip experience. All adults must be registered with their class. Adults not registered in advance must pay museum general admission cost. Unregistered parents may be turned away due to capacity regulations. Upon availability, LCM offers a private lunch space for groups at the end of a scheduled field trip

services.name: Tickets
services.desc: We strongly recommend that LCM Members and general admission guests purchase timed-entry tickets in order to guarantee your spot to play, especially on weekends and holidays. Tickets are available for purchase online. Come play with us on: Fall Hours Wednesday - Saturday 9:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. Sunday 11:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. We believe that children matter and our communities are better when kids know their immense potential. Your contributions and purchases through donations, memberships, admissions, and the gift shop help LCM fulfill our mission of being steward of education and learning. services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The joy of exploration isn’t just for kids. Events like meetings, conferences, and intimate dinners to large parties are made magical in this unique gathering space. The outdoor and indoor experiences across our 8.5 acre campus and 56,000 square foot museum leave plenty of room to create and design an exciting, playful and safe environment to celebrate. Whether you’re throwing an event for your entire organization and their families or just the team, we can customize a memorable event that will be remembered.
